callback: Callable[[], bool] in authenticated Flask request context; returns literal True to permit cookie-envelope origin. Existing trusted _private_media_origin_ok uses resolved URL_PUBLICA and ORIGENS_APP. No payload validation, no _identificacao_json_post 8KiB bound, no proxy-header inference. Without callback new cookie envelopes fail closed; request-local authenticated bearer retains previous policy.
session: Existing account generation plus transport capabilities; no extra GET.
post: POST /api/chat-jobs unchanged. Outer {account,request_id,iald_conv,iald_transport}, exact full original UTF8 JSON inside zlib/strictbase64/hash envelope. No POST query or retry added.
poll_query: transport=iald-byte-envelope-v1, exactly one occurrence; old iald_transport query does not opt in.
page_binding: kind=page, job_id and requested after cursor, authenticated account generation. Each page independent. Identity and encoded page both retain original HTTP status/type/private,no-store.
parser_scope: Global HTTP limit30MiB and pre-existing media/route outer JSON parse precede envelope wire20MiB check. Semaphore2 bounds inflate/encode only, not HTTP body reading or outer JSON parse. This is INT-04 documented residual, not all-parser protection.
legacy: Original plain POST parser/body semantics/canonical20MiB preserved; raw whitespace above20MiB still accepted when canonical body fits. Existing attachment endpoints unchanged.
client_pending: INT-02 (large valid identity page) is owned by client agent. Backend preserves original identity pages without truncating, including oversize transport/no-gain/busy compression cases. Client must preserve finite justified legacy capacity separately from envelope decoded bound.
